data.name: FileUse.Report.Meaning
data.value: Restart Manager reports applications/services using the selected path. This is not a complete handle list and does not check delete permissions. An empty list does not prove that the file is not blocked: retry the exact operation that failed. Names from Restart Manager and separately verified EXE metadata are different sources. The result applies to the query time; the file and processes may change.

data.name: FileUse.Report.NextSteps
data.value: Save your work. Review the reported application and, if appropriate, close it normally, then repeat the check and the original operation. Do not terminate system processes or services based on one result row. If the list is empty or unavailable, check file permissions, attributes, path scope, and the actual Windows error; do not disable protective software for testing.

data.name: FileUse.Report.Title
data.value: G PC Health Check — who is using a file

data.name: FileUse.Report.PreviousMeaning
data.value: Attempts are stored independently with their own paths and context. A difference between the lists does not prove that a block was removed.

data.name: FileUse.Report.RmLifecycle
data.value: Restart Manager sessions and registrations are temporarily managed by Windows. The program does not modify the selected file, read its contents, or close applications.

data.name: FileUse.Report.Privacy
data.value: Export contains both attempts in full regardless of search. Paths, application names, and account names may be sensitive.
